hero_alt: The earliest known printing of Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, 25 February 1997 (SOLD)
intro_paragraphs: I buy and sell manuscripts, documents, archives, and rare books. The best moments in this work have a distinctive quality. You are looking at something you didn't know existed. Your pulse quickens. "Is this what I think it is?" If you're lucky and the answer is yes, you feel like Indiana Jones, looking at something that no collector or historian or scholar has ever set eyes on. There's a responsibility in that moment, and you feel that too.
